name: Santa María (Boyacá, Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and blue, overlaid by a yellow lightning bolt from the upper fly to the lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Santa María, a municipality in the department of Boyacá, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: lightning bolt from the upper fly to the lower hoist
